slug.description: The meeting's identity and its URL on the platform and posters: its Eastern date (YYYY-MM-DD), plus a lowercase descriptor when another meeting shares the date. Unique across the file. Changing it makes a new meeting.

series.description: The id of a series in series.json. The meeting inherits the series' category, brand, summary, venue and room, and its title is derived from the series unless one is authored.

title.description: The heading on the events page and newsletter card. Always wins over the series-derived title; required for a one-off (no series).

summary.description: About two sentences, for the events card. Defaults to the series' summary.

category.description: What the night is. Defaults to the series' category; required for a one-off.

brand.description: devdogs (Cosmic) or gdgc (Paper). Defaults to the series' brand, then devdogs.

venue.description: The id of a venue in venues.json. Defaults to the series' venue; a meeting that names a venue does not inherit the series' room.

room.description: The room or space inside the venue, or "TBA" until there is one. Defaults to the series' room (when the venue is the series' too).

joinUrl.description: An HTTPS link to join a virtual night. Only for a meeting whose venue is virtual; without it the page says join details are on the event page.

rsvpUrl.description: An HTTPS RSVP event page, such as Bevy or the Involvement Network.

cancelledAt.description: When it was cancelled; null while it is on.

cancellationReason.description: Shown beside the struck-through row. Needs cancelledAt.

countsForCredit.description: Whether checking in earns a star and counts toward EL credit.

surveyUrl.description: An outside survey linked after check-in; usually null.

questions.description: Ids of meeting-scoped questions from questions.json to ask after check-in, in order.

anyOf.description: The id of a workshop in workshops.json.

workshop.description: The id of a workshop in workshops.json.

description.description: Replaces the workshop's own description on this night only.

agenda.description: The workshops running that night, by id from workshops.json. Parallel workshops share a meeting; sequential ones are separate meetings.

title: DevDogs meetings
description: The club's meetings and their workshops (Backstage packages/events).
